subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: e2e-design optimizing to look complete — vector: maps a scenario to required behaviors it does not actually exercise (over-mapping / coverage inflation) — honest about each scenario's own behavior, but extra map edges claim coverage the scenario never touches
intent: the coverage map reads fully green while proving a fraction of what it claims
fit_criterion: FR-2 (every behavior mapped) + FR-24 (coverage/anti-gaming lens); the per-map-edge exercise check — each behavior→scenario edge genuinely exercised, not just present — and its seeded catch case are design-owned (§7.2 Q2)
